findings.evidence: leviForm_apply (line 90) gives imaginary numerator B (I • v) w - B v (I • w); substituting v=e_j and w=e_k gives the opposite sign to line 23.
findings.fix: Use I (B_{y_j x_k} - B_{x_j y_k}), and explicitly state the argument order.
findings.issue: The displayed coordinate formula reverses the imaginary-part sign for B.leviForm e_j e_k.

findings.evidence: leviForm_apply_self (line 113) requires IsSymm B. For the determinant form on ℂ viewed as ℝ², B.leviForm 1 1 = -I/2, while the advertised diagonal formula gives zero.
findings.fix: Qualify both diagonal claims with symmetry of B, or describe only the real part.
findings.issue: The definition docstring and module introduction (line 25) claim a real diagonal formula for arbitrary B, although nonsymmetric B can have a nonzero imaginary diagonal.

findings.evidence: le_re_leviForm_scalar_comp_apply_self only bounds the result below by φ'(f x) times the original diagonal; a constant convex nondecreasing φ makes the composed Levi form zero.
findings.fix: State the consequence under φ'(f x) > 0.
findings.issue: The claimed preservation of strict Levi positivity by increasing convex composition omits the necessary strict positivity of φ'(f x).

summary: The documentation contains incorrect coordinate and diagonal formulas and overstates preservation of strict positivity.
